name: Granalkin, Archer on the Silver Pass

system.biography:
Granalkin began life as one of the Third Circle souls of Mardukth, Who Holds in Thrall. A predator of extreme skill, Granalkin was a master of the bow who placed the hunt first above all things, governed by a code of honor tied deeply to his veneration of the hunt. When Luna appeared in the skies over Creation, Granalkin was entranced as she brought a field of night to the world, and he quickly joined her on her first peregrinations. During the Primordial War, Granalkin was awed by the perfect hunting ability of the Chosen of Luna and refused to slay them, eventually aiding the Exalted in slaying Mardukth. For his actions, he was given pardon by the Unconquered Sun. Now Granalkin stalks the chasms and corridors of the moon with a mighty bow of bone and ivory, searching for aberrations from Luna's dreams and nightmares, and is charged with security on Silver Chair. He appears as an upright, humanoid being with the feathered head of a gryphon, an exoskeleton resembling that of a scorpion, lizard-like legs braced to spring and a bony, segmented tail.

Source: Glories of the Most High: Luna.
